name: Unmatched Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is unmatched.

CMIS.name: Matching Instruction Not Found
CMIS.definition: Matching instruction from the counterparty could not be found.

DDAT.name: Disagreement Settlement Date
DDAT.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the settlement date/time.

DELN.name: Disagreement Direction Of Trade
DELN.definition: Counterparty expects a delivery not a receipt, or counterparty expects a receipt not a delivery.

DEPT.name: Disagreement Place Of Settlement
DEPT.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the place of settlement.

DMON.name: Disagreement Settlement Amount
DMON.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the settlement amount.

DDEA.name: Disagreement Deal Price
DDEA.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the deal price.

DQUA.name: Disagreement Quantity
DQUA.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the quantity of the financial instrument.

CADE.name: Disagreement Repurchase Call Delay
CADE.definition: Repurchase call delay does not match.

SETR.name: Disagreement Settlement Transaction
SETR.definition: Settlement transaction type does not match.

DSEC.name: Disagreement Security
DSEC.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the security/issue, for example, ISIN or a financial instrument attribute differs.

VASU.name: Disagreement Variable Rate Support
VASU.definition: Variable rate support does not match.

DTRA.name: Not Recognised
DTRA.definition: Counterparty does not recognise the transaction.

RSPR.name: Disagreement Repurchase Spread Rate
RSPR.definition: Repurchase spread rate does not match.

RERT.name: Disagreement Repurchase Rate Type
RERT.definition: Repurchase rate type does not match.

REPP.name: Disagreement Repurchase Premium Amount
REPP.definition: Repurchase premium amount does not match.

PHYS.name: Disagreement Physical Settlement
PHYS.definition: Counterparty's instructions is for physical settlement, and yours is not, or vice versa.

IIND.name: Disagreement Common Reference
IIND.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the common reference.

FRAP.name: Disagreement Payment Code
FRAP.definition: Counterparty's instructions is for free settlement, and yours is for settlement against payment, or vice versa.

PLCE.name: Disagreement Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Place of trade does not match.

FORF.name: Disagreement Forfeit Repurchaseamount
FORF.definition: Repurchase forfeit amount does not match.

REGD.name: Disagreement Registration Details
REGD.definition: Discrepancies exist in the registration details linked to the transaction.

RTGS.name: Disagreement RTGS System
RTGS.definition: Counterparty indicates a settlement via RTGS system and you indicate non-RTGS settlement, or vice versa.

ICAG.name: Incorrect Agent
ICAG.definition: Counterparty indicated an incorrect delivery or receiving agent.

CHAR.name: Disagreement Charges Amount
CHAR.definition: Counterparty disagrees on the amount of charges.

IEXE.name: Incorrect Buyer Or Seller
IEXE.definition: Instruction indicates an incorrect buyer (receiver) or seller (deliverer).

NCRR.name: Disagreement Currency Settlement Amount
NCRR.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the currency of the settlement amount.

NMAS.name: No Matching Started
NMAS.definition: Matching process has not yet started.

SAFE.name: Disagreement Safekeeping Account
SAFE.definition: Safekeeping account used as a matching criteria on the market concerned does not match.

DTRD.name: Disagreement Trade Date
DTRD.definition: Counterparty disagrees with the trade date.

LATE.name: Your Instruction Too Late For Matching
LATE.definition: Instruction received too late for matching.
